listing.aiSummary: Enables multiplayer gameplay by allowing players to join a host's campaign and participate in battles.

description:
Ai disclaimer, this project started out as a framework for single player games being turned multiplayer months ago, as of recently everything is now completely automated with ai for the most part. Some of it is done by had but most is done with a combination of Claude and gpt.

https://github.com/blazingblazed1/Star-Sector-Multiplayer---SSMP-

This project is a few months in the making so far. We've made good progress and are close to a full release. I attempted to begin public testing of this mod through some unofficial discord (wont use names) but was met with an unmatched level of toxicity with moderation support, that I've never seen in my life. I'm hoping everyone here is looking to just play star sector with their friends because that's all I care about. There is an open ai disclaimer on the discord if you are interested. I will try to upload the latest builds here when ever i can get to it. Mods please send me a message on discord if you guys need anything from me i just wont be checking here often.

This is a WIP, there are bugs and desync occasionally fleets don't look good, but if your buddy starts a battle, even if you don't see it you can join them!

Installation
1. Download
2. Use the one click installer or Open your mods folder
3. Drag the mod in
4. Open your game and enable SSMP, then disable all other mods

How to join
1. Host creates a lobby
2. Send/Copy IROH ticket
3. Click join on your screen (Auto paste is enabled)
4. Wait for host to create campaign
5. Click join world

No other installs, No Hamachi, Just join your friends.

(Mods should work but there is no official support yet, i want to ensure i give you guys a fully functioning multiplayer mod before working on mod support, Doesn't make sense to fix the mods in patch 1.4.4 if they all break in 1.4.5 anyways)

Go have fun. I do NOT approve of any form of harassment of anyone in my discord you will be banned for individual harassment, Anyone interested in starting FIGHTS, please read that statement, If you come and start FIGHTS you will be banned from this discord, we are here to have fun not FIGHT with your fellow Star Sector enjoyers.

If anyone wants to follow along or send bug reports please join the SSMP Discord link removed -Alex (Log files, open a private thread in the bug log post, that only you and i can see for security)

There is a "how it works" public feature requests, videos of multiplayer working, and much more.

As of the latest update, fleet desync visually has been plaguing this mod, still working on this mod, you can always turn off/on the latest fleet sync with the F8 Coop menu. if the flashing bothers you it will be the next fix.

feel free to ask questions publicly about the mod, or if you're looking in the code and have questions I'm happy to answer anything you guys need, but lets make it public i would not like to go into the dms to discuss code, or anything of that nature. If you want to know something, others probably do too.. Hope you guys enjoy the progress

aiDescription: Enables multiplayer gameplay by allowing players to join a host's campaign and participate in battles. It uses a lobby system with tickets for joining, requiring no external networking tools like Hamachi. The mod is currently in pre-release testing with known issues regarding visual fleet desync.
